staging_flow.step_1: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS namespace.rudder_staging_<table> USING DELTA
staging_flow.step_2: COPY INTO namespace.rudder_staging_<table> FROM (SELECT columns FROM 'load_folder') FILEFORMAT = CSV|PARQUET
staging_flow.step_3_merge: MERGE INTO namespace.<table> AS MAIN USING (SELECT * FROM dedup_subquery) AS STAGING ON MAIN.id = STAGING.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ... WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ...
staging_flow.step_3_insert: INSERT INTO namespace.<table> (columns) SELECT columns FROM (dedup_subquery)

users_table_handling.deduplication_method: FIRST_VALUE(col, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY received_at DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
users_table_handling.identifies_union: UNION of existing users and new identifies rows by user_id

merge_key_strategy.description: Both Segment and RudderStack use 'id' as the primary merge key for MERGE INTO operations. RudderStack additionally supports 'row_id' for discards table.
merge_key_strategy.segment: id-based MERGE with deduplication via ROW_NUMBER window function
merge_key_strategy.rudderstack: id-based MERGE with ROW_NUMBER deduplication; configurable via allowMerge setting and uploader append preference; falls back to INSERT with dedup when merge disabled

partition_column_selection.description: RudderStack auto-generates an event_date partition column from received_at for all tables with a received_at column. Segment uses standard Delta table MERGE without explicit partition pruning.
partition_column_selection.segment: No explicit partition column; relies on Delta table default behavior
partition_column_selection.rudderstack: Auto-generated event_date column via DATE GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CAST(received_at AS DATE)); PARTITIONED BY(event_date); partition pruning enabled by default (Warehouse.deltalake.enablePartitionPruning=true); event_date excluded from query generation

oauth_support.description: Both platforms support OAuth for Databricks authentication. RudderStack additionally supports personal access token and STS temporary credentials for S3 staging.
oauth_support.rudderstack: Personal access token OR OAuth (useOAuth, oauthClientID, oauthClientSecret); STS temporary credentials for S3 object storage access (awsKeyId, awsSecretKey, awsSessionToken)

column_naming.description: Both platforms flatten nested event properties into snake_case column names. RudderStack uses the rudder-transformer service for column name transformation.
column_naming.rudderstack: Flattened snake_case columns (e.g., context_library_name); column naming handled by rudder-transformer

data_type_handling.description: RudderStack explicitly maps between Rudder types and Delta Lake SQL types. Semi-structured types (array, map, struct) are tracked but not directly mapped.
data_type_handling.rudderstack: Explicit type mapping: boolean→BOOLEAN, int→BIGINT, float→DOUBLE, string→STRING, datetime→TIMESTAMP, date→DATE; reverse mapping for schema discovery; unmapped semi-structured types (array, map, struct) counted via WHCounterStat

staging_and_load_flow.description: RudderStack uses a staging table approach: COPY INTO staging → MERGE or INSERT INTO final → DROP staging. Supports CSV (gzipped) and Parquet load file formats.
staging_and_load_flow.rudderstack: Staging table lifecycle: CREATE staging → COPY INTO from S3/GCS/Azure (CSV gzip or Parquet) → MERGE INTO or INSERT INTO final → DROP staging; staging tables named rudder_staging_*; max table name length 127 chars

external_location.description: RudderStack supports external Delta table locations, allowing tables to be stored at customer-specified paths outside the default catalog location.
external_location.rudderstack: Optional external location via enableExternalLocation and externalLocation config; uses CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE with LOCATION clause; format: externalLocation/namespace/tableName

context_library.description: Different SDK library identifiers in the context field.

envelope_fields.description: RudderStack includes additional envelope metadata fields not present in Segment output.
envelope_fields.segment: Standard fields: id, timestamp, sent_at, received_at, original_timestamp, uuid_ts
envelope_fields.rudderstack: Same standard fields plus auto-generated event_date partition column on tables with received_at

error_classification.description: RudderStack classifies Databricks errors into permission and resource-not-found categories for structured error handling.
rudderstack_error_types: PermissionError: User does not have permission CREATE on CATALOG

known_gaps: RudderStack uses auto-generated event_date partition column; Segment does not
RudderStack supports partition pruning optimization; Segment relies on default Delta behavior
RudderStack has configurable merge vs append modes (allowMerge, preferAppend); Segment always merges
RudderStack supports external table locations; behavior may differ from Segment managed tables
RudderStack uses staging table approach (COPY INTO staging then MERGE); Segment may use direct MERGE
RudderStack supports both CSV (gzip) and Parquet load files; Segment approach may differ
RudderStack rewrites s3:// to s3a:// for Databricks S3A client compatibility
RudderStack OAuth support includes client_id/client_secret; Segment OAuth flow may differ
RudderStack users table dedup uses FIRST_VALUE window function with UNION of identifies; Segment approach may differ
Different SDK library name in context fields (rudder-sdk-js vs analytics.js)
rudderstack_unique_features: Partition pruning for improved query performance on large datasets
Configurable merge vs append behavior per destination
STS temporary credentials for S3 access
Configurable retry with exponential backoff (1s to 300s, max 10 retries)
Error length trimming (max 64KB) for structured logging
Dangling staging table cleanup on connection close
SQL middleware with secrets redaction for sensitive credential logging

notes: Databricks Delta Lake shared warehouse destination. RudderStack internal name: DELTALAKE. Package: warehouse/integrations/deltalake/. Both platforms write to Delta tables using SQL MERGE for deduplication. Key architectural difference: RudderStack introduces an auto-generated event_date partition column and supports configurable partition pruning for query optimization on large datasets. RudderStack's staging-table-based loading flow (COPY INTO staging → MERGE/INSERT → DROP staging) provides schema evolution handling and load isolation. OAuth authentication is fully supported alongside personal access tokens. Integration testing requires DATABRICKS_INTEGRATION_TEST_CREDENTIALS and the SLOW=1 flag. Driver: databricks-sql-go via sqlconnect.
